atAGlance: Sữa chua uống is drinking yogurt, tangy, sweet, and refreshing in the Vietnamese snack-drink lane.
whatItIs: Sữa chua uống is yogurt drink served chilled. Expect drinkable yogurt that is tangy, sweet, creamy, and refreshing.
howToEnjoy: Order it when you want something tart and cooling rather than fizzy.
howLocalsOrder: Sữa chua uống is usually ordered cold. Ask ít đường if you want more yogurt tang, or ít đá if you do not want the drink watered down.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Sữa chua uống fits Vietnam’s love of dairy drinks that blur snack and refreshment.
